knowledge_point.title: Finding the Number of Pivot Columns of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 10 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we need to convert $B$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =\begin{bmatrix}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 10 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \quad {R}_{3} :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{2} \\  & ∼\begin{bmatrix}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \quad {R}_{4} :={R}_{4}+\left(- \frac{1}{3}\right){R}_{3} \\  & ∼\begin{bmatrix}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $B$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
